Name: Elliott Portrait Mod by GlassLeaf
Author: GlassLeaf
Description:
So a friend of mine wanted a frontal portrait of Elliott, since he's the only main NPC with a side-view portrait. This is my first sprite mod of this scale. I've done simple recolors in the past, but actually pixeling something (mostly) from scratch was a wonderful experience. I wanted to keep his color pallett the same, and maintain any original features (i.e. the general appearance for his "surprised" face".

To use this mod, simply open up the Portraits folder in your game's directory (path shown below) and replace Elliott.xnb with the one in the download link above-- make sure you keep a back-up in a safe place, if you so desire. For reference, my game's directory is:

[CODE]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits[/CODE]

If you like this mod, please endorse, comment, etc. As I said, I am totally new at this, so any and all feedback is very much appreciated.
Happy farming!

Downloads.Description: A frontal portrait mod for Elliott, made by GlassLeaf. Includes readme and minor tweaks.
